description: Capability for any md-reader window (main or torn-out tab). The fs: permissions that used to sit here were never exercised — the frontend does not import @tauri-apps/plugin-fs, and every file access goes through the open_file / save_file commands, which use std::fs directly. Granting the webview unscoped filesystem read+write bought nothing, and combined with unsafe HTML rendering of arbitrary documents it was a real exfiltration path. Removed with the plugin in v0.7.0.
